_comment: Golden Hen configuration — edit to customize behavior, drops, sounds, and appearance
_comment_timing: Lay interval in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Allowed range: 20 to 72000
_comment_death: Item dropped when the Golden Hen is killed. Set death_drop_count to 0 to drop nothing
_comment_drops: Weighted drop pool — higher weight = more likely. drop_count applies to non-nugget items
_comment_sounds: Use any valid Minecraft sound ID, e.g. minecraft:entity.chicken.ambient
_comment_glint: Glint overlay on body/wings/head — color is #RRGGBB, alpha range 0.0-1.0, pulse_speed controls shimmer rate
_comment_spawning: allow_spawn_egg_on_parent: right-clicking a Golden Hen with its spawn egg produces a baby
